<template>
    <v-container>
      <v-row>
        <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="4">
          <v-text-field
            v-model="inputDate"
            :label="label"
            placeholder="DD/MM/YYYY"
            @input="updateDate"
            @blur="formatDate"
            :error-messages="errorMessage || errors.date"
          >
            <template v-slot:append>
              <v-icon @click="showDatePicker = true">mdi-calendar</v-icon>
            </template>
          </v-text-field>
        </v-col>
      </v-row>
  
      <v-dialog v-model="showDatePicker" max-width="290px">
        <v-date-picker v-model="date" @update:model-value="selectDate"></v-date-picker>
      </v-dialog>
    </v-container>
  </template>
  
  <script>
  import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
  import { format, parse, isValid } from 'date-fns'
  import { useField } from 'vee-validate'

  export default {
    props: {
      modelValue: {
        type: String,
        default: '',
      },
      label: {
        type: String,
        default: 'Date',
      },
      errorMessage: {
        type: String,
        default: '',
      },
    },
    emits: ['update:modelValue'],
    setup(props, { emit }) {
      const { value: date, errorMessage: errors } = useField('date', (value) => {
        if (!value) return 'Date is required'
        const parsedDate = parse(value, 'yyyy-MM-dd', new Date())
        if (!isValid(parsedDate)) return 'Invalid date format'
        return true
      })

      const showDatePicker = ref(false)
      const inputDate = ref(props.modelValue ? format(new Date(props.modelValue), 'dd/MM/yyyy') : '')

      const updateDate = (event) => {
        const value = event.target.value
        inputDate.value = value
        if (value && value.length === 10) {
          const parsedDate = parse(value, 'dd/MM/yyyy', new Date())
          if (isValid(parsedDate)) {
            date.value = format(parsedDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            emit('update:modelValue', date.value)
          }
        } else {
          date.value = ''
          emit('update:modelValue', '')
        }
      }

      const formatDate = () => {
        if (date.value) {
          const parsedDate = parse(date.value, 'yyyy-MM-dd', new Date())
          if (isValid(parsedDate)) {
            inputDate.value = format(parsedDate, 'dd/MM/yyyy')
          }
        }
      }

      const selectDate = (newDate) => {
        date.value = newDate
        inputDate.value = format(new Date(newDate), 'dd/MM/yyyy')
        emit('update:modelValue', newDate)
        showDatePicker.value = false
      }

      watch(() => props.modelValue, (newValue) => {
        if (newValue) {
          date.value = newValue
          inputDate.value = format(new Date(newValue), 'dd/MM/yyyy')
        } else {
          date.value = ''
          inputDate.value = ''
        }
      })

      return {
        date,
        showDatePicker,
        inputDate,
        updateDate,
        formatDate,
        selectDate,
        errors,
      }
    },
  }
  </script>
